query:
UPDATE sales_groups
         SET name = $3,
             purchase_code = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE purchase_code END,
             revenue_code = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE revenue_code END,
             meta = CASE WHEN $8 THEN $9 ELSE meta END,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
